verdict.rationale: Check documents a benefits object that records benefit types, start and end dates, and employee and company contributions, which supports benefit deductions flowing into payroll. The marketing site also lists "Health benefits" and "Deductions" as features. There is no evidence that Check itself offers health insurance plans, handles carrier enrollment, or provides admin workflows; it mainly records contributions for payroll. Missing for 10: offering or sourcing health insurance plans, an enrollment workflow (open enrollment, elections), carrier sync, ops admin tooling for benefits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
